result.title: Goemans's Unsplittable-Flow Conjecture: The Anatomy of AI-Assisted Counterexample Discovery
result.summary: Goemans conjectured that any fractional single-source flow could be converted into an unsplittable flow without increasing total cost and while increasing any arc load by at most the largest demand. Recently, Dmitry Rybin announced a seven-vertex counterexample found through an interaction with ChatGPT, which disproved this long-standing conjecture. However, the interaction did not reveal why this particular topology and its demand, fractional-flow, and cost choices work together, whether the example belongs to a broader family, or which structural features determine where counterexamples can occur. It also left unclear why the AI-assisted search succeeded where earlier human efforts had not. In this paper, we develop a forward counterexample construction pipeline. It starts from an arborescence on which failure is impossible and adds terminal-entering shortcut arcs. The resulting load constraints define a finite set of admissible route choices; their convex hull, the conflict polytope, yields exact conditions for demands, fractional flows, and costs. Starting from a simple arborescence, the pipeline selects Rybin's topology and characterizes all counterexamples it supports. Experiments further demonstrate the pipeline's transferability: when instructed to follow it while varying the initial arborescence and shortcut placement, ChatGPT produced counterexamples on topologies genuinely different from Rybin's and found valid constructions starting from 93 other rooted arborescence shapes. The theory also explains why the original example was difficult to discover through blind enumeration and suggests that Rybin's interaction lies between blind enumeration and a complete theory-guided construction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为 Goemans 不可分割流猜想提出一个前向反例构造流程：在树上添加进入终端的捷径弧，用「冲突多面体」精确刻画需求、分数流与成本成立的条件，从该流程出发选定 Rybin 的七点拓扑并刻画其支持的全部反例，并实验显示按此流程引导 ChatGPT 在 93 个其他树形结构上找到反例。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其对「LLM 搜索介于盲目枚举与理论引导构造之间」的分析，可能为 LVR 中构造式搜索空间设计、验证条件刻画以及模型贡献与外部脚手架贡献的区分提供可核查的类比。
